enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping (fan on for air circulation)
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket up to the chest. Close eyes. Turn the body to the left side. Bend the left arm under the pillow. Turn the body to the right side. Stretch both legs out. Pull the blanket over the shoulder. Roll onto the back. Place both arms on top of the blanket. Turn the head to the side. Roll onto the left side again. Draw the knees up. Push the blanket down to the waist. Pull the blanket back up. Turn onto the right side. Keep breathing steadily. Stay still under the blanket. Fan runs continuously, oscillating across the room.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, stretching in bed, checking phone for messages and news (bathroom occupied by Member 2)
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Blink. Raise both arms above the head and stretch. Bend both knees and stretch the legs. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Place both feet on the floor. Reach the right hand to the bedside table. Pick up the phone. Press the power button. Unlock the screen with the thumb. Open the messaging app. Scroll down the message list with the thumb. Tap a message to open it. Read it. Scroll back to the top. Open the news app. Swipe up to scroll the headlines. Tap one article. Read it. Swipe back. Tap the home button. Place the phone back on the bedside table. Stand up. Walk one step toward the bedroom door. Stop. Wait. Turn the head toward the hallway. Sit back down on the bed. Pick up the phone again. Tap the screen. Check the time. Put the phone down.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing face, brushing teeth, morning shower with water heater, getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from Bedroom 1 to the Bathroom door. Push the door open. Step inside. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Bend over the sink. Cup both hands under the water. Splash water onto the face. Rub the face with both hands. Pick up the facial cleanser. Squeeze a small amount onto the left palm. Rub both palms together. Apply to the face with both hands. Rinse the face with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel from the hook. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel back. Pick up the toothbrush. Turn on the tap. Wet the toothbrush under the water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the toothpaste. Unscrew the cap. Squeeze toothpaste onto the brush. Put the toothpaste down. Brush the teeth. Spit into the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the mouth with water. Spit again. Turn off the tap. Put the toothbrush back in the holder. Turn on the water heater switch. Step into the shower area. Pull the shower curtain closed. Turn on the shower tap. Adjust the water temperature with the handle. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Open the cap. Pour shampoo into the left palm. Put the bottle down. Rub the shampoo into the hair with both hands. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the shower gel. Squeeze gel onto the hand. Rub over the arms, chest and legs. Rinse the body. Turn off the shower tap. Turn off the water heater switch. Push the curtain open. Step out. Pick up the towel. Rub the hair with the towel. Wipe the body dry. Pick up the clothes from the hook. Put on the underwear. Put on the trousers. Put on the shirt. Button the shirt. Turn off the bathroom light. Push the door open. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast: boiling water in the kettle, toasting bread, preparing coffee
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the upper cabinet door. Take out the kettle. Close the cabinet door. Walk to the sink. Turn on the tap. Fill the kettle with water. Turn off the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch down. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the bread and milk. Close the refrigerator door. Put the bread bag on the counter. Open the bag. Take out two slices of bread. Put the slices into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Open the cabinet door. Take out a mug. Close the door. Take out a plate and a knife. Put the coffee powder into the mug with a spoon. Pour hot water from the kettle into the mug. Stir with the spoon. Put the spoon down. Press the kettle switch off. Pick up the plate. Take the toast out of the toaster when it pops up. Put the toast on the plate. Open the butter container. Spread butter on the toast with the knife. Sit down at the table. Pick up the mug. Take a sip of coffee. Put the mug down. Pick up the toast. Bite. Chew. Swallow. Put the toast down. Take another sip of coffee. Finish the toast. Drink the rest of the coffee. Stand up. Carry the plate and mug to the sink. Rinse the plate and mug under the tap. Place them in the drying rack. Wipe the table with a cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning walk around the neighborhood and picking up a takeaway coffee
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the entry door. Pick up the keys from the hook. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Put the phone in the jacket pocket. Put on the shoes. Unlock the door. Open the door. Step outside. Close the door. Lock the door. Walk down the corridor to the stairs. Walk down the stairs. Push the building door open. Step onto the sidewalk. Walk along the street to the left. Pass the first intersection. Continue walking at a steady pace. Swing both arms. Turn right at the corner. Walk past the small park. Turn left. Walk to the coffee shop. Push the door open. Walk to the counter. Say to the barista: 'One latte to take away, please.' Take the phone out of the pocket. Tap the payment app. Hold the phone over the card reader. Put the phone back in the pocket. Take the paper cup from the counter. Say 'Thank you.' Walk out of the shop. Hold the cup in the right hand. Walk back along the same street. Turn right at the corner. Walk past the park. Turn left. Walk up the stairs to the building. Push the building door open. Walk up to the apartment door. Unlock the door. Open the door. Step inside. Close the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking phone for messages and news, tidying the living room, planning the work-from-home day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Living Room. Sit down on the sofa. Put the coffee cup on the side table. Take the phone out of the pocket. Unlock the screen. Open the messaging app. Scroll through the messages. Tap one and reply with a short text. Press send. Open the news app. Swipe through the headlines. Put the phone down on the sofa. Stand up. Pick up the cushion lying on the floor. Place it on the sofa. Pick up the mug and the empty cup from the side table. Carry them to the Kitchen. Come back to the Living Room. Pick up the remote control. Point it at the TV. Press the power button. Watch the screen for a moment. Press the power button again to turn the TV off. Put the remote down. Pick up the phone. Open the calendar app. Tap on the day's date. Read the entries. Tap the notes app. Type a list of tasks. Save the note. Put the phone in the pocket. Walk to Bedroom 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home on the computer: answering emails, drafting community program plans, updating participant records, desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Push the chair back from the desk. Sit down on the chair. Turn on the desk lamp. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Type the login password on the keyboard. Move the mouse. Open the email application. Click on the first unread email. Read it. Click reply. Type a response on the keyboard. Click send. Open the next email. Read it. Click reply. Type a reply. Click send. Open the third email. Attach a file by clicking the attachment button and selecting the document. Click send. Open the word processing document. Type the heading of the community program plan. Type the first section. Scroll down with the mouse wheel. Type the second section. Save the document with Ctrl+S. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Fill a glass with water from the tap. Walk back to Bedroom 1. Sit down again. Open the spreadsheet with the participant records. Click cell A2. Type the participant name. Press Tab. Type the contact number. Press Tab. Type the date. Scroll down. Enter the next row. Continue entering rows. Save the spreadsheet. Open the video meeting link in the browser. Adjust the headset. Open the calendar. Check the meeting time. Continue typing notes in the document. Turn the desk lamp slightly with the hand. Move the mouse. Click save. Stand up. Stretch both arms upward. Sit down again.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch using the induction cooker and microwave, then washing dishes; having lunch with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the Kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables and the container of cooked rice. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Open the cabinet door. Take out a pan. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button on the induction cooker. Press the heat setting button. Pour oil into the pan. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables on the cutting board. Put the knife down. Put the vegetables into the pan. Stir with a spatula. Open the microwave door. Put the rice container inside. Close the door. Press the start button. Wait. Press the stop button. Open the microwave door. Take out the container. Close the door. Press the induction cooker off button. Take two plates from the cabinet. Spoon the vegetables and rice onto the plates. Carry the plates to the table. Say to Member 2: 'Lunch is ready.' Sit down at the table opposite Member 2. Pick up the fork. Eat. Put the fork down. Talk with Member 2 about the morning's tasks. Pick up the fork again. Finish the food. Stand up. Carry the plates to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the plates. Pick up the sponge. Wipe the plates with dish soap. Rinse again. Put the plates into the drying rack. Turn off the tap. Wipe the counter with a cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting on the sofa with the air conditioner on, scrolling on the phone; watching TV with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Living Room. Pick up the air conditioner remote from the side table. Point it at the air conditioner. Press the power button. Press the temperature button twice. Put the remote down. Lie down on the sofa. Pull the cushion under the head. Take the phone out of the pocket. Unlock the screen. Open the social media app. Swipe up with the thumb. Scroll through the feed. Tap a video. Watch it. Swipe to the next video. Tap the like button. Swipe again. Scroll further. Put the phone down on the chest. Pick up the TV remote with the right hand. Point it at the TV. Press the power button. Press the channel button. Put the remote down on the sofa. Turn the head toward the TV screen. Say to Member 2: 'Which channel do you want?' Hand the remote to Member 2. Watch the screen. Sit up on the sofa. Pick up the phone again. Scroll through the news feed. Put the phone down. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work from home: online coordination meetings with partner organizations, writing grant notes, replying to volunteers
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 1. Sit down on the chair at the desk. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Type the login password. Open the video meeting application. Click the join meeting button. Put on the headset. Adjust the microphone. Greet the participants: 'Good afternoon, everyone.' Click the share screen button. Select the program plan document. Scroll through the document while speaking. Nod the head. Write notes on paper with a pen. Click the mute button. Click unmute. Say: 'We can adjust the schedule to the last week of the month.' Click the stop sharing button. Click leave meeting. Take off the headset. Put it on the desk. Open the document for grant notes. Type the heading. Type the first paragraph. Scroll down. Type the budget figures. Save with Ctrl+S. Open the email application. Open an email from a volunteer. Click reply. Type the response. Click send. Open the next email. Click reply. Type the response. Click send. Open the spreadsheet. Click a cell. Update the volunteer contact number. Save the file. Stand up. Stretch both arms. Sit down. Turn the desk lamp to adjust the angle. Continue typing notes until the clock shows 17:00. Save all documents. Close the laptop lid.

enriched_activities.activity: Stretching after work and vacuuming the living room floor
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Living Room. Stand in the middle of the room. Raise both arms above the head. Bend the torso to the left. Bend the torso to the right. Bend forward and reach both hands toward the floor. Straighten up. Rotate the shoulders backward. Rotate the head slowly to the left. Rotate the head to the right. Walk to the storage cabinet. Open the cabinet door. Take out the vacuum cleaner. Close the door. Plug the power cord into the wall socket. Press the power button with the foot. Push the vacuum cleaner forward across the floor. Pull it back. Push it along the sofa edge. Push it under the coffee table. Bend down. Move the chair aside with the left hand. Push the vacuum cleaner under the chair. Pull it out. Vacuum the corner near the TV stand. Pull the cord out of the socket. Wind the cord around the hook. Open the cabinet door. Put the vacuum cleaner back. Close the door. Clap both hands together to remove dust. Walk to the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Freshening up with a quick shower after the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Bathroom. Turn on the light. Turn on the water heater switch. Step into the shower area. Pull the shower curtain. Turn on the shower tap. Adjust the temperature with the handle. Step under the water. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the shower gel. Squeeze gel into the left palm. Put the bottle down. Rub the gel over the arms and chest. Rub the gel over the legs. Rinse the body under the water. Run both hands through the hair. Rinse the hair. Turn off the shower tap. Push the curtain open. Step out. Pick up the towel from the hook. Rub the hair with the towel. Wipe the body dry. Wipe the legs. Hang the towel back on the hook. Turn off the water heater switch. Turn off the light. Push the door open. Walk out of the Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, reading a book while Member 2 finishes dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Living Room. Sit down on the sofa. Reach to the side table. Pick up the book. Open the book to the bookmark. Lean back against the cushion. Read the page. Turn the page with the right hand. Continue reading. Look up at the door when Member 2 passes. Say: 'Dinner is almost ready?' Say to Member 2: 'I will cook after your turn.' Lower the eyes back to the book. Turn the page. Read another page. Place the bookmark on the page. Close the book. Put the book on the side table. Stand up. Walk toward the Kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and oven, eating dinner, loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the meat, vegetables and sauce. Close the refrigerator door. Put the items on the counter. Open the drawer. Take out the knife and cutting board. Place the cutting board on the counter. Cut the vegetables with the knife. Put the knife down. Open the oven door. Place the tray with the meat inside. Close the oven door. Turn the oven dial to set the temperature. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button. Press the heat setting button. Pour oil into the pan. Add the vegetables. Stir with a spatula. Add the sauce. Stir again. Press the off button on the induction cooker. Open the oven door. Take out the tray with oven gloves. Close the oven door. Turn the oven off. Take two plates from the cabinet. Serve the food onto the plates. Carry the plates to the table. Sit down. Say to Member 2: 'Let's eat.' Pick up the fork. Eat the meal. Put the fork down. Talk with Member 2 about the day. Pick up the fork again. Finish the food. Stand up. Carry the plates and cutlery to the sink. Rinse them under the tap. Open the dishwasher door. Pull out the lower rack. Place the plates in the rack. Place the cutlery in the basket. Push the rack in. Close the dishwasher door. Press the start button. Wipe the counter with a cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV to unwind
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Living Room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the TV remote from the side table. Point it at the TV. Press the power button. Press the channel button. Put the remote down on the cushion. Lean back against the backrest. Watch the screen. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Unlock the screen. Check a message. Put the phone down. Look back at the TV screen. Pick up the remote. Press the volume button twice. Put the remote down. Say to Member 2: 'This episode is the new one.' Pick up the remote again. Press the guide button. Scroll the program list. Press the select button. Put the remote down. Watch the screen. Stretch both arms. Cross the legs. Watch until the end of the program. Pick up the remote. Press the power button to turn the TV off. Put the remote down.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening walk around the block to get some fresh air
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the sofa. Walk to the entry door. Take the jacket off the hook. Put on the jacket. Zip up the jacket. Take the keys off the hook. Put the keys in the right pocket. Take the phone from the side table. Put the phone in the left pocket. Put on the shoes. Bend down to tie the laces. Unlock the door. Open the door. Step outside. Close the door. Lock the door. Walk down the stairs. Push the building door open. Step onto the sidewalk. Turn left. Walk along the block at a steady pace. Swing both arms. Pass the first corner. Cross the street at the crosswalk. Walk past the shop windows. Turn right at the second corner. Walk along the next street. Turn right again. Walk back toward the building. Push the building door open. Walk up the stairs. Stop at the apartment door. Take the keys out of the pocket. Unlock the door. Open the door. Step inside. Close the door. Lock the door. Take off the shoes. Hang the jacket on the hook.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing with the game console, then reading on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Living Room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the game controller from the side table. Press the power button on the console with the thumb. Wait for the screen. Use the arrow buttons to select a game. Press the start button. Hold the controller with both hands. Press the buttons with the thumbs. Tilt the controller to the left. Press the trigger button. Move the character. Press the pause button. Put the controller on the lap. Pick up the phone with the right hand. Unlock the screen. Open the reading app. Scroll to the saved article. Read it. Scroll down with the thumb. Press the home button. Put the phone down. Pick up the controller again. Press the pause button to resume. Play for a while. Press the pause button. Press the exit button. Press the power button on the console to turn it off. Put the controller on the side table. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine: washing up, brushing teeth, preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Bathroom. Turn on the light. Turn on the tap. Cup both hands under the water. Splash water onto the face. Pick up the facial cleanser. Squeeze a small amount onto the palm. Apply to the face with both hands. Rinse the face with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel from the hook. Wipe the face dry. Hang the towel back. Pick up the toothbrush. Turn on the tap. Wet the toothbrush under the water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the toothpaste. Open the cap. Squeeze toothpaste onto the brush. Close the cap. Put the toothpaste down. Brush the teeth. Spit into the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the mouth. Spit again. Turn off the tap. Put the toothbrush back in the holder. Pick up the floss. Pull out a length of floss. Floss between the teeth. Throw the floss into the bin. Turn off the light. Push the door open. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading in bed with the desk lamp on, winding down
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Turn on the desk lamp. Turn off the ceiling light. Pull the blanket down. Sit on the edge of the bed. Pick up the book from the bedside table. Open the book to the bookmark. Slide both legs under the blanket. Lie down on the back. Prop the pillow behind the head. Hold the book with both hands. Read the page. Turn the page with the right hand. Continue reading. Turn another page. Look at the phone on the bedside table. Pick up the phone with the right hand. Unlock the screen. Press the alarm button. Set the alarm for 06:40. Press save. Put the phone back on the bedside table. Pick up the book again. Read one more page. Place the bookmark on the page. Close the book. Put the book on the bedside table. Reach to the desk lamp switch. Press the switch to turn the lamp off. Slide down under the blanket. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on the back under the blanket. Close eyes. Turn onto the left side. Bend the left arm under the pillow. Turn onto the right side. Draw the knees up slightly. Pull the blanket over the shoulder. Turn onto the back again. Place both arms on top of the blanket. Turn the head to one side. Roll onto the left side. Stretch both legs out. Pull the blanket back over the chest. Turn onto the right side. Keep breathing steadily. Stay still under the blanket. Fan runs continuously, oscillating across the room.
